title: Test expected errors
summary: Some functions should reject bad input. Check that the rejection happens and that its message is useful.
introduction: Some functions should reject bad input. Check that the rejection happens and that its message is useful. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Test expected errors

blocks.text: The result is true. The function rejected division by zero with the expected message.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Test divide(4, 2) as the normal case.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A test that catches every error but checks nothing can pass for the wrong reason.
For more detail later, use this [Unit Testing further reading](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html).
